text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000334 bills 99215 at roughly nine times the complexity-adjusted expectation, mostly on patients with 0-1 chronic conditions, but records are too thin to confirm or refute the billed levels.","leaning":"pattern_consistent_with_upcoding","interpretation":"The claims pattern is consistent with upcoding. The sampled high-complexity 99215 claims (e.g., C0180518, C0181245) look plausible, so the concern centers on the low-complexity stratum. Documentation cannot settle the question: only one 99215 chart came back (C0179129, supported), and the 99214 results and the two moderate-plus data notes with no lab line on the claim are weak signals at most. A reviewer should first request charts for a targeted set of low-complexity 99215 claims, such as those listed above, to check whether the documented MDM and time support the billed level, and should watch for cloned or templated notes."}
